correctness.rationale: Positive quadratic boundary blow-up yields Hausdorff and volume convergence to the paraboloid cap. Convergent covariance kernels and total-variation comparison yield the exact endpoint norm limit. Beta-ball conditioning gives the displayed scalar maximization, and the exact tip plus convex pure-height upper bound yield d/e+O(sqrt d). The 37 standalone assertions independently check formulas, not universal claims.

originality.rationale: Compared explicit definitions and conclusions: fixed-manifold kernel projection theory and fixed-domain high-degree Christoffel asymptotics do not imply shrinking positively curved cap affine-norm universality. The exact simplicial affine norm has different limiting geometry and a different dimension coefficient. Record searches found no direct covering claim. Residual historical-priority uncertainty remains.
residual_risks: Equivalent older affine-projector result may be catalogued under Christoffel or Lebesgue constants; searched material cannot establish exhaustive absence.
The Kroó convex-domain publication was only partially accessible for complete theorem comparison.

value.rationale: Affine least-squares Lebesgue norm measures sharp worst-case amplification. The result isolates a natural degenerating-sampling regime and establishes curvature independence coupled with sharp linear dimension growth. This compares curved local domains structurally with known simplex norms; not just a routine parameter substitution.
